```{r}
n <- 5
for(i in 1:n) {
  cat(strrep(" ", n-i))
  cat(strrep("* ", i))
  cat("\n")
}
for(i in (n-1):1) {
  cat(strrep(" ", n-i))
  cat(strrep("* ", i))
  cat("\n")
}
```
```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse) # loads ggplot2, dplyr, readr, and more
```
```{r}
students <-read_csv("student_performance.csv")
```
```{r}
View(students) # opens a spreadsheet-style viewer in a new tab
```
```{r}
head(students) # shows the first 6 rows
```
```{r}
dim(students) # shows number of rows and columns
```
```{r}
View(students) # opens a spreadsheet-style viewer in a new tab
head(students) # shows the first 6 rows
dim(students) # shows number of rows and columns
```
```{r}
str(students) # shows column names, data types, and sample values
```
```{r}
summary(students) # min, max, mean, median for every numeric column
```
```{r}
colSums(is.na(students)) # counts missing (NA) values per column
```

```{r}
ggplot(students, aes(x = FinalExamScore)) +
geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
labs(title = "Distribution of Final Exam Scores",
x = "Final Exam Score", y = "Number of Students")
```
```{r}
ggplot(students, aes(x = Result, fill = Result)) +
geom_bar() +
labs(title = "Number of Students: Pass vs Fail",
x = "Result", y = "Number of Students")
```
```{r}
ggplot(students, aes(x = PartTimeJob, y = FinalExamScore, fill = PartTimeJob)) +
geom_boxplot() +
labs(title = "Final Exam Score by Part-Time Job Status",
x = "Has a Part-Time Job?", y = "Final Exam Score")
```
```{r}
ggplot(students, aes(x = StudyHoursPerWeek, y = FinalExamScore)) +
geom_point(color = "darkorange", alpha = 0.7) +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
labs(title = "Study Hours vs Final Exam Score",
x = "Study Hours per Week", y = "Final Exam Score")
```
```{r}
ggsave("study_hours_vs_score.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
